22f1000288:

But I will be allowed for the end sem exam or not as the grading doc talks about scoring atleast 40 in OPPE ?

You’ll be allowed to sit for the SC ET provided the avg. of the best 7 out of the first 9 weekly assessments (objective and programming) scores >= 40/100. It’s independent of your OPPE score.

22f1000288:

scoring atleast 40 in OPPE ?

That’s one of the eligibility criterias to get the course grade. However, it must be 35 now acc. to the revised cut-off.
